template: core = vector_neut(winsorize(ts_backfill({fundreportedequityassets},63),std=4), winsorize(ts_backfill({reported_asset_value},63),std=4)); rank_smooth = ts_mean(group_rank(core, industry), 20); is_top = greater(rank_smooth, 0.9); is_bottom = less(rank_smooth, 0.1); signal = if_else(is_top, group_zscore(core, industry), if_else(is_bottom, group_zscore(core, industry), 0)); smoothed = ts_decay_linear(signal, 5); final = scale(smoothed, scale=1)
idea: 引入时序持续性验证与衰减平滑：通过20日移动平均检验极端行业排名的持续性，过滤短期噪声；使用线性衰减替代即时信号，显著降低换手率，仅在配置偏离具备时间延续性时建仓。
